links.why: A clause cannot be joined to itself. The waw relation the builder meant is already recorded as cl0 to cl1.
Separate waw opens cl1; a plain and joining two descriptive clauses, with no cause or result.
Separate waw opens cl2; a plain and joining the darkness clause to the spirit clause.
Order reversed. cl0 (he said) is the event before cl2 (it was light), so the builder direction runs backwards.
cl1 is the speech itself, nested inside cl0. The narrative line continues from cl0, so cl1 is not the clause before cl2.
cl0 is the saying clause (he said God) and cl1 is what is said, the command let it be light. R1 content link, as well as the turn.
wayyiqtol cl2 continues the narrative from cl0, the nearest narrative clause before it that is not inside a speech.
A command (jussive, let it be light) and what it brings about (wayyiqtol, it was light). R4: a result, not a plain then.

groups.why: God (w2) is the one speaking. Members unchanged. The part is cl1, the single command, so the content is the clause and not an imperative group.
part=cl2 is not a role of the imperative group. cl2 is what the command brings about, so it is the effect.
groups.category: outcome recorded as effect, not part

links.why: cl1 (the light was good) is what God saw. It is the object of the seeing verb, not a reason. Ki after a verb of perceiving.
links.category: object clause after a verb of perceiving

links.why: Order reversed. cl0 (he saw) comes before cl2 (he separated), so the builder direction runs backwards.
wayyiqtol cl2 continues the narrative line from cl0. cl1 is inside cl0's object clause, so it is not the clause before cl2.
links.category: narrative sequence past an embedded clause

cant_tell.what: cl1 opens_with field holds a morphology code, not a conjunction
cant_tell.why: Read as having no connective. The clause is the object of cl0, so the missing conjunction does not change any link.

referents.why: Third masculine singular on the verb of cl1 (he called night). The nearest agreeing doer of the same naming in cl0 is God (w2). Elohim takes singular agreement with a singular verb, so the plural morph on the noun does not block it.
referents.category: implied subject carried over from prior clause

links.why: Order reversed. The calling of light and darkness (cl0, cl1) comes before the evening (cl2), so the builder direction runs backwards.
Plain waw opens cl1 and joins the two namings. No cause or result.
wayyiqtol cl2 continues the narrative line from cl1, which is not inside a speech.
wayyiqtol cl3 continues the narrative line from cl2.

none_fit.what: Name-giving: God called the light day and the darkness night. A naming is not a saying, so no content link fits, and no link type records giving a name.

cant_tell.what: cl4, day one, an appositional summary of the evening and morning (cl2, cl3)
cant_tell.why: The form does not settle whether it elaborates them or only closes the day. No link added.
